environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, TCP passthrough on port 443 with TLS termination at instance). No WAF attached. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Application runs as a systemd service under gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database stored on local EBS volume at /var/data/users.db. No request filtering or input validation middleware.
